title: Into the library Wednesday: The Compressed Apprenticeship - Publish / Hold
summary:
Staged Monday night on overnight-2026-11-16 (commit 770a9a4): In Review banner, tag and home card off; added to the home library and menu (19 published, 8 In Review). Opens with your line: **Read the book, not the CliffsNotes.** "Can you write a high school book report using CliffsNotes? Absolutely - but if you really want the experience, you need to read the book. AI is very good at handing you the CliffsNotes. This pattern is how you read the book with AI beside you." No post (3 posts a week).

**Image prompt (photo-realistic, from records/image-style.md - you approve the image before it goes live):** Photo-realistic image, 16:9, warm natural-light office. A woman in her early 30s at a light wood desk, laptop open beside her. Instead of just reading the screen, she has printed the AI's draft and is writing her own version in a notebook, the printout covered in her margin notes and question marks. A thick, well-used reference book lies open next to the notebook. An older colleague in his 50s leans in from the side, coffee in hand, pointing at one of her margin notes and smiling. A green plant, brass desk lamp, soft window light from the left. No logos, no brand names, no other readable text.
